correctness.rationale: The arch factorization for scattered-subsequence universality equals the greedy count of completed 0/1 arches. Pairing consecutive symbols turns Dyck words into coloured Motzkin excursions (paired height h), tracking R/Z/O arch states; each two-symbol block completes at most one arch. On first reaching a new paired height, the 00 block cannot be good because good 00 needs state O and creating that state at height h requires an earlier 11 from height h+1, impossible at the first visit. Thus max h<=d bad blocks and all fixed-deficit Dyck paths are in a finite 3(d+1)-state transfer system. G_d=e(I-zP)^(-1)[zQ(I-zP)^(-1)]^d f proves rationality for every fixed d, not joint bivariate rationality. Checked boundaries n=0 and d=0, transition table and first four displayed rational functions. Independent fresh direct enumeration of 23,714 Dyck paths for n<=10 corroborates height bound and first deficiency distributions; all-n argument is the first-height lemma plus formal matrix identity, not finite extrapolation.
